item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.33 (51)
- New: Disk Speed (Utilities › Disk Speed…). Test how fast a drive writes and reads, including flash drives: large and small transfers in MB/s with a graph, hints, and your last results. It writes one temporary file and removes it afterwards. - New: Screen Shelf keeps each new screenshot you take while "Add new screenshots to Screen Shelf" is on (the default), including one you drag from its thumbnail into another app. Saved screenshots, and your Markup edits to them, are added when XHelpers Pro can read the folder they are saved in (Desktop, Documents and Downloads need Full Disk Access). - Dictation: the floating panel's words stay in one box, in one place, from "Listening…" until the result is in, and live words appear whole. "Insert now" is a quiet row under them. - Dictation: Before and After are larger and easier to read, the same on both panels. - Dictation: "Insert at the current cursor" now goes to the window that has the keyboard, such as a floating window over another app, not to the app in front. - Dictation: GPT-6 Luna's effort is Medium unless you choose another. - Dictation: the typing-in-place input source has its own "XH" icon instead of a microphone that looked like macOS Dictation; Dictation settings offer Update… to install it. - Dictation: the floating panel shows your words larger, on a clearer background, and in full; it scrolls only when the screen runs out of room. It is a little wider and keeps more room free beside the cursor. - Dictation: the Review panel is tidier and shorter: a one-line status, a calmer Decisions API line, and GPT-6 Luna's card shows clearly when it is checking and when it has finished, with a countdown while it waits for you to stop typing. - Dictation: with "Insert at the current cursor" on, the Insert button names the app the text will go to. - Dictation: a dictation is never sent to XHelpers Pro itself unless one of its text fields has the cursor. - Dictation: Pro's own windows and alerts now open above the Dictation panels. - Dictation: the Review panel shows GPT-6 Luna's review of a result that was already inserted. - Dictation: the floating panel's language and speech model menus open under their buttons, and a model that still needs a download says so.
